events.detail: Wrong-number text asking about a golf booking
Weeks of friendly daily chat and photos
Moved the conversation to WhatsApp
Screenshots of big crypto trading profits
Deposited $1,000 on a trading site
Added savings after a small test withdrawal worked
Site demanded a 20% tax before withdrawal
Account frozen and contact went silent

snippet: A wrong-number text turned into a weeks-long friendship and a crypto 'opportunity'. After a small withdrawal worked, the victim deposited their savings and the platform then demanded a tax to release it.

events.detail: Match on a dating app
Asked to move to Telegram
Talked about a future together
Showed an uncle's insider trading app
Started with $500
Took a loan to invest more
Account 'flagged', needed a security deposit
Reverse image search found the photos elsewhere
Funds never recovered

snippet: A dating match moved the chat to Telegram and introduced a 'family' trading app. The victim borrowed to invest more before withdrawals were blocked.

events.detail: Wrong-number text from a 'business owner'
Moved to WhatsApp
Shared lifestyle photos and daily check-ins
Sent a link to a crypto platform with fake gains
Noticed the site was registered a month ago
A friend recognised the pattern
Blocked the number before depositing

snippet: A friendly wrong-number contact pushed a new crypto platform. A friend recognised the script and the victim blocked them before sending any money.

events.detail: Message on a dating app
Long conversations about family and careers
Moved to WhatsApp
Walked the victim through a 'guaranteed' trade
Deposited $500 to try it
Minimum balance required before withdrawing
Searched the platform name and found scam reports
Stopped replying and reported the site

snippet: After a first small deposit, the victim was told they needed a bigger balance to withdraw. They searched the platform, found scam reports and walked away down $500.

events.detail: Connection request from a 'finance professional'
Mentorship-style chats about markets
Invited to a private Telegram group
Group members posting profit screenshots
Limited window to join a 'signal' trade

snippet: A self-described finance mentor invited the poster into a private trading group full of profit screenshots. The poster asked whether to join the time-limited trade.

events.detail: Unsolicited text offering remote work
Moved to Telegram with a 'trainer'
Claimed to represent a known staffing agency
Dashboard showing commission from 'tasks'
Topped up $100 to unlock a task set
Combo task would expire unless funded now
Kept depositing to clear a negative balance
Earnings locked until more tasks were paid
Account closed by the 'company'

snippet: A remote 'task' job required topping up the account to unlock work. Each round needed a bigger deposit, and the earnings were never released.

events.detail: Recruiter message on a job board
Offer letter on a real company's letterhead
Interview held over a chat app
Mailed a check to buy home-office equipment
Asked to send leftover funds to a 'vendor'
Bank teller flagged the check as fraudulent
Did not send any money

snippet: A chat-only 'interview' led to a check for home-office equipment and a request to forward the extra to a vendor. A bank teller flagged the check before any money moved.

events.detail: Email inviting an application for a data entry role
Onboarding moved to a messaging app
Professional-looking onboarding documents
Gave SSN and bank login for 'direct deposit'
Bank account drained

snippet: A data entry 'onboarding' asked for an SSN and bank login to set up payroll. The account was emptied within days.

events.detail: Text claiming the poster's resume was shortlisted
Named a large online retailer as the employer
Must confirm today or lose the spot
Never applied to that company
Ignored and reported the number

snippet: A text claimed the poster was shortlisted at a big retailer and had to confirm the same day. They had never applied, so they reported it.

events.detail: WhatsApp message offering paid product reviews
Added to a Telegram 'team' channel
Paid out $20 for the first few reviews
Prepaid $150 for a 'merchant task'
Team bonus lost if the task wasn't finished
Sent several larger deposits in crypto
Channel deleted

snippet: A product review side job paid out small amounts at first, then needed prepaid 'merchant tasks'. Pressure from the 'team' pushed the victim into much larger crypto deposits.
